name: cisa-scuba
description: CISA Secure Cloud Business Applications baselines for Microsoft 365, as ScubaGear v2.0.0 states them: every check filed under an MS.AAD, MS.EXO, MS.SECURITYSUITE, MS.SHAREPOINT, MS.TEAMS, MS.POWERBI or MS.POWERPLATFORM policy id, catalog severities lifted to High for the SHALL policies carried here. checks/references/cisa-scuba.json lists every policy with the checks that cover it, or the reason none does yet. Three checks are held to the baseline's stricter reading through thresholds: a managed device to register a sign-in method (CA-017), and an address beyond the default recipients for the role alerts (ID-026, ID-027).
